# Managed by AppCrane - do not edit manually

import /etc/caddy/sites/*.caddy

crane.example.com {
    header {
        ?Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains"
        ?X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
        ?Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
        ?X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies "none"
        ?Permissions-Policy "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=()"
        -X-Powered-By
        -Server
    }

    handle /plain-sandbox* {
        request_header -X-AppCrane-Auth-Mode
        request_header X-AppCrane-Auth-Mode "authenticated"
        route {
            request_header -X-AppCrane-User
            request_header -X-AppCrane-User-Id
            request_header -X-AppCrane-User-Email
            request_header -X-AppCrane-User-Name
            request_header -X-AppCrane-User-Role
            request_header -X-AppCrane-App-Role
            request_header -X-AppCrane-Is-Admin
            request_header -X-AppCrane-App-Roles
            forward_auth 127.0.0.1:5001 {
                uri /api/identity/verify?app=plain&prefix=/plain-sandbox
                copy_headers X-AppCrane-User X-AppCrane-User-Id X-AppCrane-User-Email X-AppCrane-User-Name X-AppCrane-User-Role X-AppCrane-App-Role X-AppCrane-Is-Admin X-AppCrane-App-Roles
            }
            request_header Cookie "(^|;\s*)cc_token=[^;]*" ""
            request_header Cookie "^;\s*" ""
        }
        header Content-Security-Policy "frame-ancestors 'self' https://*.example.com https://example.com"
        header -X-Frame-Options
        uri strip_prefix /plain-sandbox
        reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:4002
    }

    handle /plain* {
        request_header -X-AppCrane-Auth-Mode
        request_header X-AppCrane-Auth-Mode "authenticated"
        route {
            request_header -X-AppCrane-User
            request_header -X-AppCrane-User-Id
            request_header -X-AppCrane-User-Email
            request_header -X-AppCrane-User-Name
            request_header -X-AppCrane-User-Role
            request_header -X-AppCrane-App-Role
            request_header -X-AppCrane-Is-Admin
            request_header -X-AppCrane-App-Roles
            forward_auth 127.0.0.1:5001 {
                uri /api/identity/verify?app=plain&prefix=/plain
                copy_headers X-AppCrane-User X-AppCrane-User-Id X-AppCrane-User-Email X-AppCrane-User-Name X-AppCrane-User-Role X-AppCrane-App-Role X-AppCrane-Is-Admin X-AppCrane-App-Roles
            }
            request_header Cookie "(^|;\s*)cc_token=[^;]*" ""
            request_header Cookie "^;\s*" ""
        }
        header Content-Security-Policy "frame-ancestors 'self' https://*.example.com https://example.com"
        header -X-Frame-Options
        uri strip_prefix /plain
        reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:4001
    }

    handle /headless-sandbox* {
        respond "Not deployed" 503
    }

    handle /headless* {
        request_header -X-AppCrane-Auth-Mode

    handle /bypasser-sandbox/ws/runner* {
        log_skip
        request_header Cookie "(^|;\s*)cc_token=[^;]*" ""
        request_header Cookie "^;\s*" ""
        request_header -X-AppCrane-User
        request_header -X-AppCrane-User-Id
        request_header -X-AppCrane-User-Email
        request_header -X-AppCrane-User-Name
        request_header -X-AppCrane-User-Role
        request_header -X-AppCrane-App-Role
        request_header -X-AppCrane-Is-Admin
        request_header -X-AppCrane-App-Roles
        request_header -X-AppCrane-Auth-Mode
        request_header X-AppCrane-Auth-Mode "bypass"
        uri strip_prefix /bypasser-sandbox
        reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:4006 {
            flush_interval -1
            transport http {
                read_timeout 0
                write_timeout 0
            }
        }
    }

    handle /bypasser/ws/runner* {
        log_skip
        request_header Cookie "(^|;\s*)cc_token=[^;]*" ""
        request_header Cookie "^;\s*" ""
        request_header -X-AppCrane-User

    handle /oldname-sandbox* {
        redir /aliased-sandbox{uri} permanent
    }

    handle /oldname* {
        redir /aliased{uri} permanent
    }

    handle /aliased-sandbox* {
        respond "Not deployed" 503
    }

    handle /aliased* {
        request_header -X-AppCrane-Auth-Mode

    handle /undeployed* {
        respond "Not deployed" 503
    }

    handle /api/service* {
        respond 404
    }

    handle {
        reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:5001
    }

    handle_errors {
        @appdown expression `{err.status_code} in [502, 503, 504]`
        handle @appdown {
            rewrite * /api/_crashed{uri}
            reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:5001
        }
    }
}

custom.test.local {
    request_header -X-AppCrane-User
    request_header -X-AppCrane-User-Id
    request_header -X-AppCrane-User-Email
    request_header -X-AppCrane-User-Name
    request_header -X-AppCrane-User-Role
    request_header -X-AppCrane-App-Role
    request_header -X-AppCrane-Is-Admin
    request_header -X-AppCrane-App-Roles
    request_header -X-AppCrane-Auth-Mode
    request_header X-AppCrane-Auth-Mode "bypass"
    request_header Cookie "(^|;\s*)cc_token=[^;]*" ""
    request_header Cookie "^;\s*" ""
    reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:4007
}

old.test.local {
    redir https://custom.test.local{uri} permanent
}
